cards.name: Wyrmrest Purifier
cards.text: Battlecry: Transform all Neutral cards in your deck into random cards from your class.
cards.flavorText: She keeps your deck classy.

cards.name: Wyvern's Slumber
cards.text: Choose One - Summon two Dormant Dreadseeds; or Deal 2 damage to all minions.
cards.flavorText: But watch, as soon as you try to go to sleep it'll be running all around the house making a bunch of noise.

cards.name: X-21 Repairbot
cards.text: Deathrattle: Return any Mechs Magnetized to this to your hand.
cards.flavorText: The circle bolt goes in the square hole.

cards.name: XB-488 Disposalbot
cards.text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage randomly split among all enemy minions. Forge: Gain Lifesteal.
cards.flavorText: You'll be so surprised when you figure out what XB stands for.

cards.name: XB-931 Housekeeper
cards.text: After you use a location, gain 3 Armor.
cards.flavorText: "WHAT IS MY PURPOSE?" "You gain Armor." "OH GOD."

cards.name: Xaril, Poisoned Mind
cards.text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Add a random Toxin card to your hand.
cards.flavorText: It's basically your own fault if you go around drinking weird green potions handed out by creepy mantid dudes.

cards.name: Xavius
cards.text: After you play a card, summon a 2/1 Satyr.
cards.flavorText: Xavius has grand nightmares of summoning Sargeras into this world, but a few Satyr will have to do for now.

cards.name: Xel'noth Behemoth
cards.text: Deathrattle: Summon two random 1-Cost minions. Give your minions +3 Attack.
cards.flavorText: It would be truly terrifying if a void creature came forth from the void with an un-apostrophized name.

cards.name: Xhilag of the Abyss
cards.text: Colossal +4 At the start of your turn, increase the damage of Xhilag's Stalks by 1.
cards.flavorText: When ancient heroes drove a felhunter into the sea, they thought it was the end. But for Xhilag, it was only the beginning...

cards.name: Xor'toth, Breaker of Stars
cards.text: Battlecry: Add two Stars to both sides of your hand. When they collide, deal 5 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavorText: We started his stats at 50,000,000,000/50,000,000,000 to be lore-accurate, but it was just a nudge too powerful.

cards.name: Xyrella
cards.text: Battlecry: If you've restored Health this turn, deal that much damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavorText: On the Night of Falling Stars, Xyrella had a vision of a shattered naaru. "Go to the Barrens," the being said. "Seek the shards of my broken body. Restore me, and I will restore your daughter."

cards.name: Xyrella, the Devout
cards.text: Battlecry: Trigger the Deathrattle of every friendly minion that died this game.
cards.flavorText: Xyrella thought she was only saving her daughter. Her actions may very well have saved the entire world.

cards.name: Y'Shaarj, Rage Unbound
cards.text: At the end of your turn, put a minion from your deck into the battlefield.
cards.flavorText: When he's working out, he binds all that rage back into a ponytail.

cards.name: Y'Shaarj, Titan Bane
cards.text: Old God. Battlecry: If you've spent 30 Mana on minions this game, gain Immune for 1 turn. (30 left!)
cards.flavorText: "Gargantuan Slitherer" + "Kronn the Impaler" + ("Therazane the Earthmother" - "Neptulon, Lord of Tides")

cards.name: Y'Shaarj, the Defiler
cards.text: Battlecry: Add a copy of each Corrupted card you've played this game to your hand. They cost (0) this turn.
cards.flavorText: Y'Shaarj made an excellent office intern, doing the copying AND defiling.

cards.name: Yamato Cannon
cards.text: Starship Piece Battlecry: Destroy a random enemy minion. Also triggers on launch.
cards.flavorText: Ya-may-to, Ya-mah-to

cards.name: Yelling Yodeler
cards.text: Battlecry: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle twice.
cards.flavorText: Maybe it's OK for the Grimtotem to destroy some music forever.

cards.name: Yesterloc
cards.text: At the end of your turn,& give your other minions +1 Health.
cards.flavorText: *nostalgic mrrgls*

cards.name: Ymirjar Deathbringer
cards.text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Spend 3 Corpses to summon a 3/3 Risen Ymirjar with Taunt.
cards.flavorText: Purple cotton candy is the snack of choice in Ymirheim.

cards.name: Ymirjar Frostbreaker
cards.text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Attack for each Frost spell in your hand.
cards.flavorText: Also gains +1 Attack for each time your opponent mispronounces his name.

cards.name: Yogg in the Box
cards.text: Cast 5 random spells. If your deck has no minions, the spells cast cost (5) or more.
cards.flavorText: POP! Goes the Old God!

cards.name: Yogg-Saron, Hope's End
cards.text: Battlecry: Cast a random spell for each spell you've cast this game (targets chosen randomly).
cards.flavorText: I spell your doom... Y-O-U-R D-O-O-M!

cards.name: Yogg-Saron, Master of Fate
cards.text: Battlecry: If you've cast 10 spells this game, spin the Wheel of Yogg-Saron. ( left!) (Ready!)
cards.flavorText: Yogg take the wheel!

cards.name: Yogg-Saron, Unleashed
cards.text: Titan After this uses an ability, cast two random spells.
cards.flavorText: Has been known to monologue before he strikes.

cards.name: Yoink!
cards.text: Discover a Hero Power and set its Cost to (0). Swap back after 2 uses.
cards.flavorText: Saying the spell’s name makes it work better.

cards.name: Young Dragonhawk
cards.text: Windfury
cards.flavorText: They were the inspiration for the championship Taurenball team: The Dragonhawks.

cards.name: Young Priestess
cards.text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +1 Health.
cards.flavorText: She can't wait to learn Power Word: Fortitude Rank 2.

cards.name: Youthful Brewmaster
cards.text: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion from the battlefield to your hand.
cards.flavorText: His youthful enthusiasm doesn’t always equal excellence in his brews. Don’t drink the Mogu Stout!

cards.name: Yrel, Beacon of Hope
cards.text: Rush Deathrattle: Get three different Librams from an older timeline!
cards.flavorText: Yrel has a lot of overdue library books.

cards.name: Ysera
cards.text: At the end of your turn, get two random Dream cards.
cards.flavorText: Ysera rules the Emerald Dream. Which is some kind of green-mirror-version of the real world, or something?

cards.name: Ysera the Dreamer
cards.text: Battlecry: Add one of each Dream card to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Quick! Quick! Write it down before you forget them all!

cards.name: Ysera, Emerald Aspect
cards.text: Start of Game: Increase both players'maximum Mana by 5. Battlecry: Gain 3 Mana Crystals.
cards.flavorText: She was previously Yuhsera, with a ‘yuh’.

cards.name: Ysera, Unleashed
cards.text: Battlecry: Shuffle 7 Dream Portals into your deck. When drawn, summon a random Dragon.
cards.flavorText: Releash the Dragon!

cards.name: Ysiel Windsinger
cards.text: Battlecry: Your spells cost (1) this turn.
cards.flavorText: Reach down into your lungs. The wind that resides there is your greatest treasure. It provides the gift of song, which is free. *But not less than (1)

cards.name: Ysondre
cards.text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Summon a random Dragon for each time Ysondre has died this game.
cards.flavorText: Because sondre!

cards.name: ZOMBEEEES!!!
cards.text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, summon four 1/1 Zombees to attack it.
cards.flavorText: In your brain, in your brain, Zombees, Zombees, Zombees-ees-ees.

cards.name: Za'qul
cards.text: Your Abyssal Curses heal you for the damage they deal. Battlecry: Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
cards.flavorText: Everything’s going exzaq’ully to plan.

cards.name: Zai, the Incredible
cards.text: Battlecry: Copy the left- and right-most cards in your hand.
cards.flavorText: Following this act will be her younger brother, Frank the Mediocre.

cards.name: Zakajz the Corruptor
cards.text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of minions in your hand and deck by (1) and increase the Cost of spells by (1).
cards.flavorText: WHERE ARE MY TOOTHBRUSHES!!!

cards.name: Zandalari Templar
cards.text: Battlecry: If you've restored 10 Health this game, gain +4/+4 and Taunt. ( left!) (Ready!)
cards.flavorText: YOU WERE A TEMPLAR, JONDAR!

cards.name: Zap!
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Overload: (1)
cards.flavorText: The material components for this spell are wool socks and a rug.

cards.name: Zaqali Flamemancer
cards.text: Battlecry: If every card in your hand is of a different Cost, reduce their Costs by (2).
cards.flavorText: What's the difference between a pyromancer and a flamemancer? One knows their Greek roots, the other BURNS THEM DOWN!

cards.name: Zayle, Shadow Cloak
cards.text: You start the game with one of Zayle's EVIL Decks!
cards.flavorText: E.V.I.L. is the new black.

cards.name: Zealous Initiate
cards.text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: Ok, Initiate. You need to settle down and do your job. In this case, that means die so someone else can get a minor buff.

cards.name: Zentimo
cards.text: Whenever you target a minion with a spell, cast it again on its neighbors.
cards.flavorText: Serenity. Peace. Many frogs.

cards.name: Zephrys the Great
cards.text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, wish for the perfect card.
cards.flavorText: "Of course it's perfect, you're just not seeing how to use it."

cards.name: Zer'Ontu
cards.text: Taunt. Battlecry: Summon a 0, 1, and 2-Attack minion from your deck. Gain their stats.
cards.flavorText: Do Zer'Onto others as you would have them do Zer'Ontu you.

cards.name: Zerek's Cloning Gallery
cards.text: Summon a 1/1 copy of each minion in your deck.
cards.flavorText: Cloning can be a jarring experience.

cards.name: Zerek, Master Cloner
cards.text: Deathrattle: If you've cast any spells on this minion, resummon it.
cards.flavorText: His original name was Aerek. Then the first clone was Berek. They went evil around Merek.

cards.name: Zergling
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon a 1/1 Zergling.
cards.flavorText: It's all fun and games until 8 of these show up at your door at the 2 minute mark.

cards.name: Zilliax
cards.text: Magnetic Divine Shield, Taunt, Lifesteal, Rush
cards.flavorText: Everything but the kitchen sink. Oh wait, there's one on his back.

cards.name: Zilliax Deluxe 3000
cards.text: While building your deck, customize your very own Zilliax Deluxe 3000!
cards.flavorText: It only took us 2998 prototypes to figure out how to make the perfect card... by having YOU do it!

cards.name: Zixor, Apex Predator
cards.text: Rush Deathrattle: Shuffle 'Zixor Prime' into your deck.
cards.flavorText: A living terror. Teleports at will. Feasts on tainted helboar meat. No head scritches unless you're Leoroxx.

cards.name: Zok Fogsnout
cards.text: Battlecry: Summon two / Quilboar with Taunt. (Improved by your hero Attack \& Armor gained this turn!)
cards.flavorText: Despite having only 3 digits on each hand, Zok plays Bass like he has 5.

cards.name: Zola the Gorgon
cards.text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly minion. Add a Golden copy of it to your hand.
cards.flavorText: Her name seems a bit cheesy.

cards.name: Zombie Chow
cards.text: Deathrattle: Restore 5 Health to the enemy hero.
cards.flavorText: Zombie. It's what's for dinner.

cards.name: Zoobot
cards.text: Battlecry: Give a random friendly Beast, Dragon, and Murloc +1/+1.
cards.flavorText: The Murloc is taking the picture.

cards.name: Zul'Drak Ritualist
cards.text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon three random 1-Cost minions for your opponent.
cards.flavorText: Generosity is a core value in cult culture.

cards.name: Zul'jin
cards.text: Battlecry: Cast all spells you've played this game (targets chosen randomly).
cards.flavorText: If you can dodge an axe, you can dodge a ball.

cards.name: Zuramat's Prison
cards.text: Choose a card to discard to summon a 5/5 Taunt. Deathrattle: Free Zuramat who plays one each turn!
cards.flavorText: WETVAC MODE ACTIVATE!
